A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-stalker-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Stalker]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Stalker (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Stalker (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. Probe droids deploy free to sites related to same system.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Stalker” and a white italic “E”. The slip's type line reads “CAPITAL: IMPERIAL CLASS STAR DESTROYER”, without the hyphen and the italics of the printed card's “''Imperial''-class”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
